ribbon.title: Positions
ribbon.description: The Computational Multiphysics Research Group (CoMPhys Lab) focuses on developing advanced computational models to study complex thermomechanical systems involving moving boundaries, multiphase interactions, and high strain-rate physics. Our research spans a broad range of applications—from bioinspired flight to droplet evaporation, energetic material dynamics, and hypersonic reentry physics.

sections.title: Ph.D. / M.S. (by Research) – January 2027 Intake @ IIT Madras
sections.description: Applications for the January 2027 intake have closed and interviews are currently in progress. Shortlisted candidates are contacted by the Institute. Candidates who listed the group as a preference are welcome to write to us about research topics.

sections.title: Next Round: July 2027 Intake
sections.description: The group takes Ph.D. and M.S. (by Research) students through the IIT Madras research admissions held twice a year. Motivated candidates are invited to apply in the next round in the following thrust areas:
points: 🌿 Bioinspired Flight & Structures: unsteady aerodynamics of flapping and folding wings, origami structures and architected materials.
🌀 Fluid–Structure Interaction: two-way coupled simulation of flow with thin shells, membranes and moving bodies.
💥 Energetic Materials & Solid Propellants: shock initiation, detonation physics and microstructure-resolved burning.
☄️ Hypersonic Reentry & Thermal Protection: aerothermal loads, ablation and porous heat-shield materials.
🛠️ High Strain-Rate Material Response: deformation, failure and fracture under impact and blast.
🤖 AI-Driven Multi-Scale Modeling: machine learning combined with multiscale physics and in-house solver development.
info: 📅 Application dates: announced on the IIT Madras research admissions portal

✅ Eligibility: Strong academic background in Aerospace, Mechanical, Applied Physics, or allied fields. Admission through written test & interview. Syllabus: https://ae.iitm.ac.in/documents/Interview_Syllabus.pdf
✉️ Contact: Interested candidates may write directly to pkseshadri@iitm.ac.in

sections.title: Research Internships
sections.description: We host summer and winter research interns from institutes across India; 39 students have interned with the group since November 2025. To apply, write to pkseshadri@iitm.ac.in with your CV, the period you are available, and the area you would like to work in.
info: 👥 Past interns and their projects: see the Interns tab on the People page
